strings.research.heading: Money and wealth, from first principles
strings.research.copy: This guide links the same research pipeline to three surfaces: markdown, publication-grade TeX/PDF, and the website. Cycle_019 keeps all three aligned through the question bank, source ledger, methods layer, and side-product execution notes before claims are translated into guidance.
strings.research.point1: Distinction-first answers on money creation, ownership, leverage, inequality, and risk.
strings.research.point2: Primary-source coverage across Fed, NY Fed, BLS, Census, IMF, BIS, World Bank, OECD, and SEC resources.
strings.research.point3: Question -> evidence -> claim workflow with SQ-5 source quality gates.
strings.research.point4: Operational additions: household stress dashboard, credit-conditions transmission check, and QE-5/HS-8/LL-6/DP-5 methods for decision-ready monitoring.
strings.research.point5: Latest additions: a channel-map lens from system credit to household outcomes, plus EV-7 entry-vs-incumbent tests for ownership access timing.
strings.research.point6: Cycle 007-010 sync: liquidity-and-cycle clock checks (H.4.1/H.8/NFCI/TIC/MTS/ECI/NBER), entry-and-property-price pulse checks (BFS/BDS/RPP/CPP/GLI/LPC/STEO), credit-access-and-burden bridge checks (DDP/SCE Credit Access/CEX PUMD/SIPP/OECD), and cadence-aware stress classification checks (release calendar/chargeoff/G.17/FSIC/SOI PUF) with EP-6, CAB-9, and CAS-10 wiring.
strings.research.point7: Cycle 011 extension: 9.10 Constraint-first lens for money-growth episodes, plus the new HC-5 historical-case conversion method to connect major episodes (for example Jekyll Island, Great Depression, Great Inflation, 1973-74 Oil Shock) to actionable ownership decisions.
strings.research.point8: Cycle 012-017 extension: 9.11 Money, debt, and physical constraints decision map, 9.10.1 Great Recession transmission, 9.11.1 Historical constraint test: 1973-74 oil shock and transmission lag, and CHM-6/HCT-6 alignment across publication and route surfaces.
strings.research.point9: Cycle_019 execution layer: website/README/surface alignment stays current through 30D-SW execution checks, CHM-6 evidence mapping, and guide action routes.
strings.research.cardCopy: Core questions, practical methods, official datasets, and decision-ready explanations tied to real evidence.
strings.research.asset1Desc: A practical field guide to money, wealth, debt, and physical capacity with distinction checklists, evidence ladders, stress dashboards, credit channel maps, ownership-entry execution loops, liquidity-access-valuation-burden sequencing, historical constraint tests (Great Recession and 1973–74 oil shock), constrained-vs-countercase comparisons, and source-linked methods you can apply immediately.
strings.research.asset2Desc: Timeless principles blended with modern automation ideas, capital allocation tables, quarterly rituals, and name ideas for future Lazy Money drops.

strings.research.heading: Money and wealth, from first principles
strings.research.copy: 我們正在建立一部關於金錢、財富、所有權、複利與財務獨立的動態指南。它以可重複的精煉流程運行：問題庫、來源分類、方法手冊，並同步更新書本、PDF 與網站內容。Cycle_019 增加第 9 章的證據映射層，將高影響主張鏈到問題 ID、來源狀態、反例與決策檢核後再進入槓桿或負債時機結論。
strings.research.point1: Distinction-first answers on money creation, ownership, leverage, inequality, and risk.
strings.research.point2: Primary-source coverage across Fed, NY Fed, BLS, Census, IMF, BIS, World Bank, OECD, and SEC resources.
strings.research.point3: Question -> evidence -> claim workflow with SQ-5 source quality gates.
strings.research.point4: 新增操作層：家戶壓力儀表板、信用條件傳導檢查，以及 QE-5/HS-8/LL-6/DP-5 方法，用於可決策監測。
strings.research.point5: 最新補充：新增從系統信用到家戶結果的傳導地圖視角，並加入 EV-7 的新進者與既有者進入測試。
strings.research.point6: Cycle 007-010 同步：新增流動性與循環時鐘（H.4.1/H.8/NFCI/TIC/MTS/ECI/NBER）、入場與資產價格脈衝檢查（BFS/BDS/RPP/CPP/GLI/LPC/STEO）、信用可得性與負擔橋接檢查（DDP/SCE Credit Access/CEX PUMD/SIPP/OECD），以及節奏感知壓力分類檢查（release calendar/chargeoff/G.17/FSIC/SOI PUF），並加入 EP-6、CAB-9 與 CAS-10 佈線。
strings.research.point7: 循環 011 補充：加入「9.10 先行約束視角」，並用新的 HC-5 歷史案例轉化方法，將關鍵事件（如 Jekyll Island、1929 年大蕭條、Great Inflation、1973-74 石油危機）對應到可執行的所有權決策。
strings.research.point8: Cycle_019 擴展：新增 9.11 貨幣、債務與實體約束決策圖，並加入 9.10.1 大衰退傳導、9.11.1（1973-74 石油衝擊）歷史約束測試，配合 CHM-6 在發佈面與路徑面同步映射高影響主張。
strings.research.point9: Cycle_019 證據映射層：CHM-6 保持第 9 章核心主張與問題 ID、來源狀態標籤、可反駁條件及決策用途檢核一致。

strings.research.copy: We are building a living field guide to money, wealth, ownership, compounding, and financial independence. strings.research.point2: Primary-source coverage across Fed, NY Fed, BLS, Census, IMF, BIS, World Bank, OECD, and SEC resources.

strings.hero.cardFoot: 쉬는 동안 계속해서 비용을 지불하는 간단한 루프입니다. 루프를 조정하고 라운지 기금을 늘리세요.
strings.section1.heading: 0에서 시작하기 위한 지루하지 않은 청사진
strings.section1.copy: 처음부터 수익 창출(Earn From Scratch)은 천천히 진행되는 스타터 키트입니다. 호기심으로 시작하고, 라운지 라이프스타일을 존중하면서도 여전히 수익을 쌓을 수 있다는 증거입니다.
strings.section1.card1Body: 집착, 질문, 좌절감을 포착하세요. 모든 게으른 돈의 순환은 가만히 있기를 거부하는 매력에서 시작됩니다.
strings.section1.card2Body: 공개적으로 프로토타입을 만들고 작은 증명 루프를 구축한 다음 지루한 부분을 자동화하세요. 갈기갈기 찢지 않고 호기심에 기반한 공예를 할 뿐입니다.
strings.section1.card3Body: 멤버십, 템플릿, 미니 서비스를 계층화하여 수익 흐름이 포근한 담요처럼 겹쳐지도록 합니다.
strings.section2.heading: Lazy Earn은 노력을 허공으로 바꿉니다.
strings.section2.copy: 반복 가능한 승리를 자동화하기 위한 창의적인 시스템입니다. 우리는 편안한 시스템을 설계하여 우리의 두뇌가 휴가를 보내고 수입이 계속 유입되도록 합니다.
strings.section2.feature1: ✨ 당신이 자는 동안 판매되는 영화 같은 랜딩 페이지.
strings.section2.feature2: 🔁 조금씩 움직이고, 판매하고, 전달하는 자동화 의식.
strings.section2.meterCopy: 목표는 더 많이 벌고, 더 많이 하품하고, 덜 서두르는 것입니다. Lazy Earn은 "영원히 주말"의 기본 분위기를 유지합니다.

strings.section3.copy: 귀하의 에너지에 맞는 게으른 루프를 선택하십시오. 리믹스하세요. 레이어링하세요. 나머지 날을 소유하십시오.

strings.research.heading: Money and wealth, from first principles
strings.research.copy: We are building a living field guide to money, wealth, ownership, compounding, and financial independence. It now runs with a reproducible refinery loop: question bank, source ledger, methods playbook, and synced book/PDF/website outputs. Cycle_019 adds chapter-level evidence mapping in Chapter 9 plus explicit irreversibility routing before leverage or debt-timing claims.

strings.research.point2: Primary-source coverage across Fed, NY Fed, BLS, Census, IMF, BIS, World Bank, OECD, and SEC resources.
strings.research.point3: Question -> evidence -> claim workflow with SQ-5 source quality gates.
strings.research.point4: Operational additions: household stress dashboard, credit-conditions transmission check, and QE-5/HS-8/LL-6/DP-5 methods for decision-ready monitoring.
strings.research.point5: Latest additions: a channel-map lens from system credit to household outcomes, plus EV-7 entry-vs-incumbent tests for ownership access timing.
strings.research.point6: Cycle 007-010 sync: liquidity-and-cycle clock checks (H.4.1/H.8/NFCI/TIC/MTS/ECI/NBER), entry-and-property-price pulse checks (BFS/BDS/RPP/CPP/GLI/LPC/STEO), credit-access-and-burden bridge checks (DDP/SCE Credit Access/CEX PUMD/SIPP/OECD), and cadence-aware stress classification checks (release calendar/chargeoff/G.17/FSIC/SOI PUF) with EP-6, CAB-9, and CAS-10 wiring.

strings.section1.heading: Kế hoạch không nhàm chán để bắt đầu từ con số 0
strings.section1.copy: Kiếm tiền từ đầu là bộ công cụ khởi đầu có tốc độ ghi chậm của chúng tôi. Đó là bằng chứng cho thấy bạn có thể bắt đầu bằng sự tò mò, tôn vinh lối sống trong phòng khách mà vẫn thu được doanh thu.

strings.section1.card3Body: Tạo lớp thành viên, mẫu và dịch vụ nhỏ để các luồng doanh thu chồng lên nhau như những tấm chăn ấm cúng.
strings.section2.heading: Lazy Earn biến nỗ lực thành không khí.
strings.section2.copy: Đó là một hệ thống sáng tạo để tự động hóa các chiến thắng lặp lại. Chúng tôi thiết kế những hệ thống êm ái để bộ não của chúng tôi luôn được nghỉ ngơi và thu nhập của chúng tôi tiếp tục chảy vào.

strings.section1.heading: المخطط غير الممل للبدء من الصفر
strings.section1.copy: إن برنامج Earn From Scratch هو مجموعتنا المبدئية بطيئة الحرق. إنه دليل على أنه يمكنك البدء بالفضول، وتكريم أسلوب حياة الصالة، والاستمرار في تكديس الإيرادات.
strings.section1.card1Body: التقاط الهواجس، والأسئلة، أو الإحباط. تبدأ كل حلقة مالية كسولة بسحر يرفض الجلوس ساكنًا.
strings.section1.card2Body: نموذج أولي علنيًا، وقم ببناء حلقات إثبات صغيرة، ثم قم بأتمتة الأجزاء المملة. لا يوجد طحن، فقط حرفة يقودها الفضول.
strings.section1.card3Body: طبقات العضوية والقوالب والخدمات المصغرة بحيث تتداخل تدفقات الإيرادات مثل البطانيات المريحة.
strings.section2.heading: Lazy Earn يحول الجهد إلى هواء.
strings.section2.copy: إنه نظام مبتكر لأتمتة الانتصارات المتكررة. نحن نصمم أنظمة سهلة بحيث تظل أدمغتنا في إجازة ويستمر دخلنا في التدفق.
strings.section2.feature1: ✨ صفحات مقصودة سينمائية يتم بيعها أثناء نومك.
strings.section2.feature2: 🔁 طقوس الأتمتة التي تدفع وتبيع وتسلم.
strings.section2.feature3: 🧠 خزائن الأفكار التي يتم إعادة مزجها تعمل على تكوين قطرات دائمة الخضرة.
strings.section2.meterCopy: الهدف: كسب المزيد، والتثاؤب أكثر، والاندفاع أقل. يحافظ Lazy Earn على الأجواء الأساسية في "عطلة نهاية الأسبوع إلى الأبد".
strings.section3.heading: اختر نكهتك للدخل السهل
strings.section3.copy: اختر الحلقة الكسولة التي تتناسب مع طاقتك. ريمكس لهم. طبقة لهم. تملك أيام الراحة.
strings.idea.card1Body: يمكنك تحقيق الدخل من جمالية غرفة المعيشة الخاصة بك من خلال لوحات المزاج وقوائم التشغيل وحزم المنتجات "السحابية البطيئة" القابلة للتنزيل.
strings.idea.card2Body: قم بتسجيل ثلاث ملاحظات صوتية خفيفة، وقم بتحويلها إلى ملفات بودكاست صغيرة مدتها أسبوع والتي تتخللها رعاية دائمة الخضرة.
strings.idea.card3Body: قم بتنظيم صفحة واحدة من الأدوات الممتعة. قم بتضمين الصفقات الجديدة تلقائيًا، وإقرانها مع بواب التسوق القائم على الذكاء الاصطناعي، واحصل على دخل بسيط.
strings.idea.card4Body: استضافة نيران الفصلية. قم بتدريس المخطط في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع، وقم بتسليم الأتمتة، وجمع عائدات الخريجين.
strings.idea.card5Body: قم بتحويل كل رسالة مباشرة وسطح ومستند متكرر إلى حزمة قوالب. حزمة، ترخيص، تناول العشاء من الإتاوات.
strings.idea.card6Body: تحليلات ذات مظهر هادئ تراقب الزحام الجانبي. اشحن لوحة القيادة بالإضافة إلى الأجواء.
strings.section4.heading: قم بتدوير تجربة كسب كسولة
strings.section4.copy: اضغط على المولد، واحصل على مفهوم جديد للكسب من الصفر ممزوج بصلصة Lazy Money. قم بتشغيله في نهاية هذا الأسبوع، وقم بتشغيله تلقائيًا بعد ذلك.
strings.idea.default: اضغط على الزر لتكشف عن حلقة الدخل المريحة التالية.

strings.section5.copy: اشترك في رسالة Lazy Earn، واطلب الدعوات إلى القوالب الجديدة، وشاهد التجارب المتطورة تتكشف في الوقت الفعلي.

strings.research.heading: Money and wealth, from first principles
strings.research.copy: We are building a living field guide to money, wealth, ownership, compounding, and financial independence. It now runs with a reproducible refinery loop: question bank, source ledger, methods playbook, and synced book/PDF/website outputs. Cycle_019 adds chapter-level evidence mapping in Chapter 9 plus explicit irreversibility routing before leverage or debt-timing claims.
strings.research.point1: Distinction-first answers on money creation, ownership, leverage, inequality, and risk.
strings.research.point2: Primary-source coverage across Fed, NY Fed, BLS, Census, IMF, BIS, World Bank, OECD, and SEC resources.
strings.research.point3: Question -> evidence -> claim workflow with SQ-5 source quality gates.
strings.research.point4: Operational additions: household stress dashboard, credit-conditions transmission check, and QE-5/HS-8/LL-6/DP-5 methods for decision-ready monitoring.
strings.research.point5: Latest additions: a channel-map lens from system credit to household outcomes, plus EV-7 entry-vs-incumbent tests for ownership access timing.
strings.research.point6: Cycle 007-010 sync: liquidity-and-cycle clock checks (H.4.1/H.8/NFCI/TIC/MTS/ECI/NBER), entry-and-property-price pulse checks (BFS/BDS/RPP/CPP/GLI/LPC/STEO), credit-access-and-burden bridge checks (DDP/SCE Credit Access/CEX PUMD/SIPP/OECD), and cadence-aware stress classification checks (release calendar/chargeoff/G.17/FSIC/SOI PUF) with EP-6, CAB-9, and CAS-10 wiring.
strings.research.point7: تمديد الدورة 011: إضافة منظور 9.10 "القيود أولاً" مع أسلوب التحويل التاريخي HC-5 لربط محطات تاريخية كبيرة مثل جزيرة جيكيل، الكساد الكبير، التضخم الكبير، وصدمة النفط 1973-74 بقرارات ملكية قابلة للتنفيذ.
strings.research.point8: Cycle_019 extension: 9.11 Money, debt, and physical constraints decision map, with chapter-level 9.10.1 Great Recession transmission and 9.11.1 historical transmission tests before durable allocation claims, plus CHM-6 evidence alignment across publication and route surfaces.
strings.research.point9: Cycle_019 evidence-mapping layer: CHM-6 keeps Chapter 9 high-impact claims linked to question IDs, source-state tags, falsifiers, and decision-use checks before each reader-facing update.

strings.hero.eyebrow: Argent paresseux • Gagner paresseusement • Gagner à partir de zéro
strings.hero.copy: Earn.lazying.art est une galerie vivante de concepts d'argent paresseux. Nous mélangeons les fondations Earn From Scratch avec des automatisations ludiques pour que chaque source de revenus ressemble à une journée de détente.
strings.hero.cardFoot: Une boucle simple qui continue de vous payer pendant que vous vous détendez. Ajustez la boucle, augmentez le fonds du salon.
strings.section1.heading: Le plan peu ennuyeux pour repartir de zéro
strings.section1.copy: Earn From Scratch est notre kit de démarrage à combustion lente. C'est la preuve que vous pouvez commencer par la curiosité, honorer le style de vie lounge et continuer à générer des revenus.
strings.section1.card1Body: Capturez les obsessions, les questions ou les frustrations. Chaque boucle d’argent paresseuse commence par une fascination qui refuse de rester immobile.
strings.section1.card2Body: Prototypez en public, créez de petites boucles de preuve, puis automatisez les éléments ennuyeux. Pas de contrainte, juste un artisanat motivé par la curiosité.
strings.section1.card3Body: Superposez les adhésions, les modèles et les mini-services afin que les flux de revenus se chevauchent comme des couvertures douillettes.
strings.section2.heading: Lazy Earn transforme l'effort en air.
strings.section2.copy: Il s'agit d'un système créatif pour automatiser des victoires reproductibles. Nous concevons des systèmes confortables pour que notre cerveau reste en vacances et que nos revenus continuent d'affluer.
strings.section2.feature1: ✨ Des pages de destination cinématographiques qui se vendent pendant que vous dormez.
strings.section2.feature2: 🔁 Des rituels d'automatisation qui poussent, vendent et livrent.
strings.section2.feature3: 🧠 Des coffres à idées qui remixent le travail en gouttes à feuilles persistantes.
strings.section2.meterCopy: Le but : gagner plus, bâiller plus, se précipiter moins. Lazy Earn conserve l'ambiance de base du "week-end pour toujours".
strings.section3.heading: Choisissez votre type de revenu sans effort
strings.section3.copy: Choisissez la boucle paresseuse qui correspond à votre énergie. Remixez-les. Superposez-les. Possédez les jours de repos.
strings.idea.card1Body: Monétisez l'esthétique de votre salon avec des moodboards, des listes de lecture et des offres groupées de produits « nuage paresseux » téléchargeables.
strings.idea.card2Body: Enregistrez trois notes vocales à grignoter, transformez-les en micro podcasts d'une semaine qui suscitent un parrainage permanent.
strings.idea.card3Body: Organisez une seule page d’outils indulgents. Intégrez automatiquement de nouvelles offres, associez-vous à un concierge commercial IA, collectez des revenus indirects.
strings.idea.card4Title: Gagnez à partir de cohortes de zéro
strings.idea.card4Body: Organisez des feux de camp trimestriels. Enseignez le plan le week-end, transférez les automatisations, collectez les redevances des anciens élèves.
strings.idea.card5Body: Transformez chaque DM, deck et document répété en un pack de modèles. Regroupez, autorisez, dînez avec des redevances.
strings.idea.card6Body: Des analyses calmes qui surveillent les activités secondaires. Chargez le tableau de bord et l'ambiance.
strings.section4.heading: Lancez une expérience de gain paresseuse
strings.section4.copy: Appuyez sur le générateur et obtenez un nouveau concept Earn From Scratch imprégné de sauce Lazy Money. Exécutez-le ce week-end, automatisez-le ensuite.
strings.idea.default: Appuyez sur le bouton pour révéler votre prochaine boucle de revenus détendue.
strings.section5.heading: Gagnez, détendez-vous, répétez.
strings.section5.copy: Abonnez-vous à la lettre Lazy Earn, réclamez des invitations à de nouveaux modèles et regardez des expériences exagérées se dérouler en temps réel.

strings.hero.copy: Earn.lazying.art es una galería viviente de conceptos de dinero perezoso. Combinamos las bases de Earn From Scratch con divertidas automatizaciones para que cada flujo de ingresos se sienta como un día de descanso.
strings.hero.cardFoot: Un bucle simple que te sigue pagando mientras te relajas. Sintonice el circuito, haga crecer el fondo del salón.
strings.section1.heading: El sencillo modelo para empezar de cero
strings.section1.copy: Earn From Scratch es nuestro kit de inicio lento. Es una prueba de que se puede empezar con curiosidad, respetar el estilo de vida lounge y aún así acumular ingresos.
strings.section1.card1Body: Captar obsesiones, preguntas o frustraciones. Todo bucle de dinero perezoso comienza con una fascinación que se niega a quedarse quieta.
strings.section1.card2Body: Haga un prototipo en público, cree pequeños bucles de prueba y luego automatice las partes aburridas. Sin rutinas, solo artesanía guiada por la curiosidad.
strings.section1.card3Body: Coloque capas de membresías, plantillas y miniservicios para que los flujos de ingresos se superpongan como mantas acogedoras.
strings.section2.heading: Lazy Earn convierte el esfuerzo en aire.
strings.section2.copy: Es un sistema creativo para automatizar ganancias repetibles. Diseñamos sistemas cómodos para que nuestros cerebros permanezcan de vacaciones y nuestros ingresos sigan llegando.
strings.section2.feature1: ✨ Landing pages cinematográficas que se venden mientras duermes.
strings.section2.feature2: 🔁 Rituales de automatización que empujan, venden y entregan.
strings.section2.feature3: 🧠 Las bóvedas de ideas que remezclan funcionan en gotas de hoja perenne.
strings.section2.meterCopy: El objetivo: ganar más, bostezar más, apresurarse menos. Lazy Earn mantiene el ambiente básico de "fin de semana para siempre".
strings.section3.heading: Elige tu sabor de ingresos sin esfuerzo
strings.section3.copy: Elige el circuito perezoso que coincida con tu energía. Vuelva a mezclarlos. Colóquelos en capas. Sea dueño de los días de descanso.

strings.idea.card2Body: Grabe tres notas de voz agradables y conviértalas en micropodcasts de una semana de duración que goteen un patrocinio permanente.
strings.idea.card3Body: Crea una sola página de herramientas indulgentes. Incorpore automáticamente nuevas ofertas, combínelas con el conserje de compras de IA y obtenga ingresos blandos.
strings.idea.card4Body: Organice fogatas trimestralmente. Enseñe el plano los fines de semana, transfiera automatizaciones, cobre regalías de exalumnos.
strings.idea.card5Body: Convierte cada DM, mazo y documento repetido en un paquete de plantillas. Paquetes, licencias, cenas con regalías.

strings.research.heading: Money and wealth, from first principles
strings.research.copy: We are building a living field guide to money, wealth, ownership, compounding, and financial independence. It now runs with a reproducible refinery loop: question bank, source ledger, methods playbook, and synced book/PDF/website outputs. Cycle_019 adds chapter-level evidence mapping in Chapter 9 plus explicit irreversibility routing before leverage or debt-timing claims.
strings.research.point1: Distinction-first answers on money creation, ownership, leverage, inequality, and risk.
strings.research.point2: Primary-source coverage across Fed, NY Fed, BLS, Census, IMF, BIS, World Bank, OECD, and SEC resources.
strings.research.point3: Question -> evidence -> claim workflow with SQ-5 source quality gates.
strings.research.point4: Operational additions: household stress dashboard, credit-conditions transmission check, and QE-5/HS-8/LL-6/DP-5 methods for decision-ready monitoring.
strings.research.point5: Latest additions: a channel-map lens from system credit to household outcomes, plus EV-7 entry-vs-incumbent tests for ownership access timing.
strings.research.point6: Cycle 007-010 sync: liquidity-and-cycle clock checks (H.4.1/H.8/NFCI/TIC/MTS/ECI/NBER), entry-and-property-price pulse checks (BFS/BDS/RPP/CPP/GLI/LPC/STEO), credit-access-and-burden bridge checks (DDP/SCE Credit Access/CEX PUMD/SIPP/OECD), and cadence-aware stress classification checks (release calendar/chargeoff/G.17/FSIC/SOI PUF) with EP-6, CAB-9, and CAS-10 wiring.
strings.research.point7: Extensión del ciclo 011: agrega la lente de restricción primero 9.10 y el método HC-5 de conversión de casos históricos para conectar episodios clave (Jekyll Island, Gran Depresión, Gran Inflación, choque petrolero de 1973-74) con decisiones de acceso a la propiedad accionables.
strings.research.point8: Cycle_019 extension: 9.11 Money, debt, and physical constraints decision map, with chapter-level 9.10.1 Great Recession transmission and 9.11.1 historical transmission tests before durable allocation claims, plus CHM-6 evidence alignment across publication and route surfaces.
strings.research.point9: Cycle_019 evidence-mapping layer: CHM-6 keeps Chapter 9 high-impact claims linked to question IDs, source-state tags, falsifiers, and decision-use checks before each reader-facing update.
strings.research.routeIntro: Start at the Chapter 9 transmission sequence to align your interpretation before any allocation or leverage conclusion:

strings.research.routeStep6: `9.11.4` Irreversibility gate for durable wealth decisions
